cards.headline: Ang Mo Kio market reopens after upgrading; AI robot deployed to help cleaners
bullets: Ang Mo Kio Market & Food Centre reopened on Aug 9 after two months of upgrading.
New tables, chairs, fans, and toilets were added to the market.
Bird spikes were installed to improve cleanliness and reduce bird nuisance.
An AI robot named Little Red Bot will help sweep the market area.
The robot can pick up litter and alert cleaners when its bin is full.

cards.headline: BlackRock, ResMed and Thales chiefs among MNC leaders honoured in National Day Awards
bullets: Three multinational company chiefs received the Public Service Star award.
BlackRock's CEO advised Singapore on global economy and AI.
ResMed's CEO helped grow the company's Singapore presence.
Thales' CEO expanded the firm's Asian hub in Singapore.

cards.headline: Sunda slow loris found in industrial estate near Tuas released after 2 months
bullets: A Sunda slow loris was released back into the wild after two months of care.
Workers found the endangered primate in an industrial building near Tuas.
This is the second slow loris ACRES has rescued this year.
The animal was rehabilitated and monitored closely before its release.

cards.headline: Chief Justice, former head of Council of Presidential Advisers receive top National Day honours
bullets: Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon and former CPA chairman Eddie Teo get top honours.
They will receive the Republic’s highest civilian award, the Order of Temasek.
Over 7,490 people are receiving National Day honours this year.
Menon led the judiciary for 14 years, modernising courts and justice.
Teo served nearly five decades in public service, including defence and the CPA.

cards.headline: From crowd control to spectator care: Meet the people keeping NDP 2026 safe
bullets: About 60 people from various agencies manage safety and security for the National Day Parade.
They watch CCTV cameras from 5am, checking roads and the stadium area.
The team faces challenges like coordinating different agencies and managing more entry points at the National Stadium.
Special teams help spectators needing mobility assistance get to lifts quickly.
They are also opening more lanes to manage the large crowds expected.

cards.headline: 'Senator, I’m Singaporean': The viral Singapore moments that took the internet by storm
bullets: TikTok CEO Chew Shou Zi told a US senator, 'Senator, I’m Singaporean' during a hearing.
Model Chuando Tan's 60th birthday post went viral globally, with many doubting his age.
A Hougang police anti-scam video with ASP Benjamin Cheah became a worldwide hit.
The crime show Crimewatch's lines like 'Melvin is no name for a gang member' became memes.

cards.headline: Singapore designer Faezah Shaharuddin is taking Malay cultural references to the world through furniture
bullets: Singapore designer Faezah Shaharuddin names furniture collections after Malay desserts like Onde and Biskut.
Her designs blend Southeast Asian craft traditions with childhood memories.
Studio Kallang uses furniture to express cultural memory and identity.
Faezah draws on her upbringing in furniture workshops and a culturally rich household.
Her work has been showcased internationally at events like Milan Design Week.

cards.headline: Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon, former CPA chairman Eddie Teo receive Singapore's highest civilian honour
bullets: Chief Justice Menon and Eddie Teo received Singapore's highest civilian honour.
They are among 7,491 people recognised in this year's National Day Awards.
Menon led reforms to strengthen courts' capabilities and digital transformation.
Teo served 35 years in the Public Service, including in defence and home affairs.

cards.headline: Major review underway to support families across life's journey: PM Wong in National Day Message 2026
bullets: PM Wong announced a major review of government support for families throughout their lives.
The review will look into costs of raising children and childcare access.
More details on the family support plans will be shared at the National Day Rally on August 23.
PM Wong also addressed global uncertainties and their impact on Singapore.
He assured Singaporeans that the government will stand by them amidst challenges.

cards.headline: Woman arrested in Singapore as part of probe into Fun Coffee investment scheme
bullets: A 49-year-old woman was arrested here for promoting a suspicious investment scheme called Fun Coffee.
The scheme, possibly based in Vietnam, asked users to invest using cryptocurrency.
It promised high returns and rewards for recruiting others, similar to a pyramid scheme.
People in Singapore could not withdraw their money after investing in the Fun Coffee app.
Over 220 complaints were made about Fun Coffee in Hong Kong and Macau, with victims losing millions.

cards.headline: Toyota RAV4 Hybrid review: Why this is more of an engineering masterpiece than an EV
bullets: The Toyota RAV4 Hybrid uses about 5.1 litres of fuel for every 100km.
This hybrid SUV has a roomy and bright interior, with plenty of space for passengers.
It offers solid roadholding and a composed ride, even on rough roads.
The car's engine and braking system work together smoothly, making it an engineering feat.
Despite its practicality, it lacks a 360-degree parking camera, a feature on cheaper cars.

cards.headline: Tan Kim Choo, wife of Ng Teng Fong, dies at 100
bullets: Tan Kim Choo, wife of Far East Organization founder Ng Teng Fong, has died at age 100.
She was the company's biggest shareholder, owning half of Far East Organization Pte Ltd.
The family controls several listed companies in Singapore and Hong Kong.
In 2011, the family donated S$100 million to build Ng Teng Fong General Hospital.

cards.headline: A picturesque London suburb feels the Ted Lasso effect
bullets: Richmond hotels saw up to twice as many American guests since the show started.
Fans visit Richmond, London, to see spots featured in the TV show Ted Lasso.
A shop selling Ted Lasso merchandise in Richmond gets 80% of its sales in person.
Local tours of Ted Lasso filming locations in Richmond are popular, mostly with North Americans.

cards.headline: Football, marathons, F1 and more: Adidas going all-in for sports sponsorship
bullets: Adidas is now the official partner for the Singapore Lions football team's new jerseys.
The sportswear brand is also sponsoring the upcoming BYD Singapore International Marathon.
Adidas has returned to sponsoring Formula 1, partnering with Mercedes-AMG Petronas.
The company is involved in various sports like running, tennis, and pickleball.

cards.headline: Wee Hur donates S$1.5 million to SUTD to support students’ innovation efforts
bullets: Wee Hur donated S$1.5 million to SUTD for student innovation.
The money will fund the university's Design AI Innovation & Venture Exploration programme.
This programme helps students test ideas, start ventures, and go on overseas learning trips.
Funds will also create a Wee Hur Think Tank space on campus for student projects.

cards.headline: Tommy Koh, 88, retires from MFA after 55 years
bullets: Tommy Koh is retiring from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs after 55 years of service.
He will be moving to the NUS Centre for International Law from September.
Koh received a lifetime distinguished service award from the MFA.
He served under every foreign minister since Singapore's first.

cards.headline: MSE has no mandate on land use planning for Gillman Barracks & Maju Forest: Grace Fu
bullets: Housing will be built at Gillman Barracks and Maju Forest.
The Environment Ministry does not decide on land use for these sites.
The National Development Ministry handles land use planning.
The government balances housing needs with environmental concerns.

cards.headline: Man, 22, allegedly reversed into petrol station attendant causing death, drove without valid licence while on drugs
bullets: A 22-year-old man faces eight charges after allegedly reversing into a petrol station attendant, causing his death.
The attendant, 69, fell and hit his head after the car door struck him while he was refueling.
The driver was allegedly high on drugs and driving a deregistered car without a valid licence.
He fled the scene with a passenger after the incident, leaving the attendant unconscious.
The attendant died in hospital the next day.

cards.headline: 24 Most Exciting Openings In Singapore To Look Forward To Within The Next 10 Years
bullets: Two new MRT stations, Xilin and Sungei Bedok, will open by late 2026.
Punggol Digital District, a new smart area with jobs and a university campus, opens fully in 2026.
New nature parks and trails are opening, including a 500m forest valley walk.
More cycling paths are coming to Ang Mo Kio by 2026.
A new integrated development for seniors in Yew Tee opens by 2027.

cards.headline: All You Need To Know About The Violinist, The Award-Winning SG Animated Film Hitting Cinemas This Sep
bullets: The Violinist, an SG animated film set in old Singapore, hits cinemas on September 17th.
It won the top award at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival.
The film tells the story of a Peranakan girl's musical journey and search for a friend.
Local talents like Tan Kheng Hua and Adrian Pang lend their voices to the characters.
It also won an award for its original music, composed by Ricky Ho and Isabel Latorre.
